title: Relative pseudo-coherence forces quasi-coherent cohomology above the amplitude bound
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S locally of finite type and E in D(O_X) that is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S, the sheaves H^i(E) are quasi-coherent for i > m, and if E is pseudo-coherent relative to S then E lies in D_QCoh(O_X). The retained proof is written out: choose affine open covers trivializing the equivalent characterization (lemma-relatively-pseudo-coherent), reduce to a closed immersion i : X -> A^n_S with Ri_*E m-pseudo-coherent, use the absolute pseudo-coherent criterion (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma-pseudo-coherent) to get quasi-coherence of H^q(Ri_*E) above the bound, descend through the exactness of i_* (Morphisms, lemma-i-star-equivalence) and add the sheaf-comparison footnote identifying the descended module with H^q(E) via Modules, lemma-i-star-equivalence. Retained author proof at lines 16712-16732.
